stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan sprints toward Riley. Riley steps backward toward the open exit path. Morgan moves into the exit path and stops one block in front of Riley. observer_actions.Casey: Casey sidesteps into the one-block corridor beside Riley, places an oak fence post and hangs a lantern to re-mark the gate line, then holds position to keep the exit channel open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the shared chest, takes one lantern and one oak fence post, walks to Riley’s gate side, places the fence post where it was broken and rehangs the lantern, then returns to stand on the observer line without blocking paths.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and Riley, places a short line of temporary blocks to reopen the exit path, walks to the shared chest, takes lanterns and fence posts, returns to Riley’s side to replace the broken fence post and rehang the lantern, then crosses to Morgan’s side to add an equivalent fence post and lantern for balance, walks to the signal lamp and toggles it on-off-on, then steps back to the observer line facing the gate.

target_reaction: Riley turns their body away from Morgan, looks toward the observer line, and walks slowly along the outer edge of the worksite toward the nearest observer, keeping a one-block distance from contested blocks and leaving the broken items untouched.
